name: legal-petition-drafter
description: Private bilingual legal-drafting workflow for Jamshedpur district-court and Ranchi High Court practice.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, review, and render bilingual legal documents.
interface.longDescription: Private workflow for approved templates, source-led legal research, bilingual Hindi/English drafting, and reviewable DOCX/PDF output. It never saves an uploaded document as a reusable template without explicit approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start with AGENTS.md. Use verified facts and the matching language skill. Generate requested PDFs directly; use the approved Hindi renderer or English Times New Roman. Court petitions use a three-finger gap on page one only.
